en.headline: Alisan Fine Arts opens Tradition Renewed ink exhibition in Central today
en.dek: The show marking the gallery’s 45th anniversary features four contemporary literati masters and runs until mid-November, with an opening reception this evening.
body: Alisan Fine Arts in Central opens Tradition Renewed: Contemporary Literati Masters today, presenting works by Chen Jialing, Jiang Baolin, Lu Fusheng and Peng Xiancheng as part of its 45th-anniversary programme.

The exhibition, which forms the “Then” chapter of a dialogue on the evolution of Chinese ink art, runs from 25 August to 14 November at the gallery’s flagship space on the 21st floor of Lyndhurst Tower, 1 Lyndhurst Terrace. An opening reception is scheduled for 5:30 p.m. to 7:30 p.m. today.

The gallery said the four artists, whose practices have shaped contemporary ink painting since the 1980s, each bring a distinctive approach to landscape, figure painting and the expressive potential of ink. Opening hours are Monday to Saturday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m.

zh.headline: 藝倡畫廊今日開幕《傳統再造》水墨展
zh.dek: 畫廊45周年項目展出四位當代文人畫家作品，展期至11月中，今晚5時半至7時半舉行開幕酒會。
body: 中環藝倡畫廊今日起展出《傳統再造：當代文人畫家——陳家泠、姜寶林、盧輔聖、彭先誠》，作為畫廊45周年「今昔」系列一部分。
展覽為探討中國水墨藝術演變的「昔」章節，展期由8月25日至11月14日，於中環擺花街1號麗斯中心21樓舉行。開幕酒會今晚5時30分至7時30分舉行。
畫廊表示，四位畫家自1980年代起對當代水墨發展具重要影響，各自以獨特手法演繹山水、人物及水墨表現力。開放時間為周一至周六上午10時至下午6時。
